purpose: Verified 10-record batch 129 from the 141-record difficult reference-dependent tail. This is the largest currently safe batch: a three-spell inheritance family, three printing-distinct Vile Death records, and four source-complete creation/summoning spells with external stat blocks intentionally left as references.

spells/spider-form-lesser-1131.name: Spider Form, Lesser
spells/spider-form-lesser-1131.effectSummary: Transforms you into the form and abilities of a Medium fiendish monstrous spider under the polymorph subschool rules. For adjudicating special abilities gained from the fiendish template, you are treated as having the spider's 2 Hit Dice. You gain 5 temporary hit points that disappear when the spell ends. Casting time is 1 swift action; range Personal; duration 1 round per caster level (D).
spells/spider-form-lesser-1131.notes: Manually source-reviewed and digest-locked. The spell's form size, effective Hit Dice, and temporary hit points are explicit. The fiendish monstrous spider statistics, fiendish-template details, and general polymorph-subschoool rules remain external source references rather than being reconstructed.

spells/vile-death-3200.name: Vile Death
spells/vile-death-3200.effectSummary: Calls a fiend from Hell or the Abyss and binds it into a corporeal undead creature, applying the fiendish template to the undead. Both the undead creature and the fiend receive Will saves to negate the effect; either can voluntarily fail under the circumstances described by the source. The resulting creature is independent and initially indifferent toward you. Casting time is 1 hour; range Touch; duration permanent (D); spell resistance applies. Arcane material component: a bit of brimstone.
spells/vile-death-3200.notes: Manually source-reviewed and digest-locked. This Savage Species printing is 3.0 material and is intentionally kept distinct from the later no-save Heroes of Horror/Spell Compendium versions. The fiendish template itself remains a Monster Manual reference.

spells/minor-servitor-3237.name: Minor Servitor
spells/minor-servitor-3237.effectSummary: Imbues one nonmagical inanimate object or mass of raw matter with mobility and a semblance of life, up to 1 cubic foot per caster level. The animated object is friendly toward you and serves specific tasks if you communicate your desires, but you gain no special empathy or connection to it. It gains 1 Hit Die per cubic foot of volume, Intelligence 3d6, and Charisma 1d3; its other animated-object statistics come from the Monster Manual. Casting time is 1 day; range Touch; duration permanent (D). Material component: material matching the animated object. XP cost: 250 XP per cubic foot affected.
spells/minor-servitor-3237.notes: Manually source-reviewed and digest-locked. All spell-created HD, Intelligence, Charisma, friendliness, volume, material, and XP mechanics are explicit; only generic animated-object statistics remain external.

provenance.role: primary Savage Species catalog record and digest source

spells/liveoak-2831.name: Liveoak
spells/liveoak-2831.effectSummary: Turns one healthy Huge oak into a guardian treant. Only one Liveoak can be active from you at a time. The tree must be within 10 feet of your dwelling, in a place sacred to you, or within 300 feet of something you want guarded. You set a triggering phrase of up to one word per caster level; when triggered, the oak animates as a treant. If dispelled, it immediately takes root wherever it is; if you release the spell, it tries to return to its original location before rooting. Casting time is 10 minutes; range Touch; duration 1 day per caster level (D); no save; no spell resistance.
spells/liveoak-2831.notes: Manually source-reviewed and digest-locked. Triggering, location, exclusivity, and rooting behavior are explicit. Treant statistics remain an external Monster Manual reference.

spells/summon-swarm-2459.name: Summon Swarm
spells/summon-swarm-2459.effectSummary: Summons one swarm of bats, rats, or spiders, chosen when cast. The swarm attacks all other creatures in its area and can be summoned into an occupied area. If no living creature is in its area, it attacks or pursues the nearest creature as best it can. You have no control over its target or direction of travel. Casting time is 1 full round; range Close; duration concentration plus 2 rounds; saving throw none; spell resistance no. Arcane material component: a square of red cloth.
spells/summon-swarm-2459.notes: Manually source-reviewed and digest-locked. The spell's lack of control and targeting behavior are explicit; bat, rat, and spider swarm statistics remain external Monster Manual references.

provenance.role: primary Player's Handbook v.3.5 catalog record and digest source

spells/summon-marked-homunculus-4871.name: Summon Marked Homunculus
spells/summon-marked-homunculus-4871.effectSummary: Allows a caster with the Mark of Making to summon one special homunculus for 1 hour per caster level (D). With a least Mark of Making, the choices are dedicated wright, expeditions messenger, furtive filcher, or arbalester. With a more powerful Mark of Making, you can instead summon a true homunculus, iron defender, packmate, or persistent harrier. A glyph resembling your dragonmark appears on the summoned creature. If it is reduced to 0 hit points, it explodes for 1d6 damage to all adjacent creatures except you. Casting time is 1 full round; range Close; no save; no spell resistance. Material component: a pinch of dragonshard dust; dragonmark requirement: any Mark of Making.
spells/summon-marked-homunculus-4871.notes: Manually source-reviewed and digest-locked. Eligibility tiers, summon choices, glyph, and 0-hit-point explosion are explicit. The individual homunculus stat blocks remain external ECS/Magic of Eberron/Monster Manual references.

provenance.role: primary Dragonmarked catalog record and digest source
